tools.name: create_backlog_quest
tools.description: Read-only: choose exactly one title from an ordered 2–12 game backlog and return the selected game, session length, mood, language, and a ready-to-follow time-boxed instruction. It never launches, buys, installs, modifies, or accesses a game or account. Use quick to start immediately, focus for one

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "create_backlog_quest" stacks urgency/override words (immediately, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.
